name: gitc
description: A fast, minimal git client: commit graph, branching, rebase and conflict resolution in a single native binary.
author: Adrien Boitelle

scripts.test: node src/ui/__tests__/selection.test.ts && node src/ui/__tests__/pathTree.test.ts && node src/ui/__tests__/gitCommand.test.ts && node src/ui/__tests__/patch.test.ts && node src/ui/__tests__/staging.test.ts && node src/engine/__tests__/graph.test.ts && node src/ui/__tests__/wordDiff.test.ts && node src/ui/__tests__/version.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run version:sync && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:ui && npm run embed && node scripts/build.mjs
